zh-CN: 舍繁变化而取斗战极致，以棍势、暴击与破甲压垮强敌。
en-US: Abandon complexity for martial supremacy, crushing foes through staff combat, critical strikes, and armour breaking.

zh-CN: 近战武器暴击时，额外增加一个武器伤害骰。
en-US: When you score a critical hit with a melee weapon, roll one additional weapon damage die.

zh-CN: 你的暴击阈值降低1，通常可在自然骰19或20时造成暴击。
en-US: Your critical hit threshold is reduced by 1, normally allowing critical hits on a natural 19 or 20.

zh-CN: 领悟破天一棒，以仙力驱动金箍棒重创并撕开敌人防御。
en-US: Learn Heaven-Breaking Strike, driving your staff with Sage Qi to crush a foe and tear open its defence.

zh-CN: 消耗2点仙力发动主手武器重击，额外造成2d8力场伤害，并使目标护甲等级降低2点，持续2回合。
en-US: Spend 2 Sage Qi on a main-hand weapon strike that deals an additional 2d8 Force damage and reduces the target's Armour Class by 2 for 2 rounds.

zh-CN: 护势被破，护甲等级降低2点。
en-US: Its defence has been shattered, reducing Armour Class by 2.
